objective: Optimizer/model superiority through learned state-dependent credit assignment, not changed inputs or score normalization.
motivation: Primary categoricalCE failed against scalarJS:0.764573 vs0.748147. Predeclared categoricalCEJS reached0.740715 on the same6.03Mstock-bar observations, a modest0.993%relativeMSE gain. Strongest current learned baseline is therefore retained, not replaced by weaker Adam alone.
hypothesis: One globally shared dense representation mixes gradients from distinct states. Four small jointly trained specialists with learned input-dependent responsibilities can reduce interference. Routing is optimized by prediction error, not a hand-crafted variance/novelty gate.

model.experts: Four independent tanh257-64-64-1 experts;256 total first-layer units. Same four expert initializations across all specialist arms/LRs; seed1 with distinct deterministic expert seeds.
model.router: Softmax of a learned linear257->4 map, initiallyzero/uniform. No entropy regularizer, load-balancing loss, routing labels, top-k selection, forgetting, resets, or imposed clipping.
model.credit: For masked mean squared loss, dL/df_e=2(m-y)a_e/n; dL/drouterlogit_e=2(m-y)a_e(f_e-m)/n. The latter trains current-state allocation from relative expert predictions. All forecasts precede label updates.
model.optimizer: Vanilla Adam or exactly the existing prior-history postAdam positivepart cumulativeS1/S2 evidence gate, kappa1. No added optimizer rate.
model.budget: Specialists use fewer effective parameters than the132097-parameter dense scalar network; report exact counts, not padded allocation as capacity. Shared batched runtime cannot establish standalone speed superiority.

controls.dense: Delegate frozen v1 learner without changing initialization or update rules.
controls.uniform: Identical experts with equal fixed routing.
controls.constant: Identical experts with learned router biases but zero fixed input-router weights. Distinguishes state dependence from selecting a globally better expert mixture.
controls.state_adam: Same state-routed architecture without the cumulative evidence gate. Distinguishes architecture from evidence-gating complementarity.

data.cohort: Next200eligible stocks by frozen panel universe rank, rank_offset200, new cache/tmp/panel_distributional_rank200.npz; verify actual stock-symbol disjointness against original/tmp/panel_cache.npz, not rank alone. SPY market features are shared by design.
data.within_run: Everyarm has identical frozenBank features,targets,masks,ordering,mu and seed1; all257inputfeatures unchanged. No added available bar or target transformation.
data.between_runs: New-cohort scores are not directly comparable to first-cohort v1 scores. Confirm superiority ONLY through matched within-cohort controls.
data.normalization: FrozenBank mean uses first60% labels; shared assumption explicitly retained. No test-suffix normalization fitting.

selection.prefix: Same full prequential stream, independent seven-family LR locks from [floor(.4T),floor(.6T)); first/minimum LR tie-break. Lock before barfloor(.6T). No model resets.
selection.primary: state_moe_js, fixed before seeing new-cohort results.
selection.forward: All consumed last40% bars; full file requested, automatic pruning only. Endpoint winners flagged; no suffixLR/family reselection.
selection.permuted: If informative, fresh learners on frozenBank target+valid time permutation; inherit allreal locks and source/data hashes. Not an independent-sign conditional-mean null.

acceptance.superiority: Primary must materially beat scalarJS and categoricalCEJS, not merely scalarAdam.
acceptance.mechanism: Primary must beat both uniformMoEJS and learnedconstantMoEJS to support state-conditioned specialization. Compare stateMoEAdam to attribute evidence-gate contribution.
acceptance.evidence: All42candidates retained, paired valid-sample SSE/MSE,8chronologicalblocks including censoredpartialblocks explicitly, counts, selectedLRs, parameterbudgets, rawartifacts and clocks. No claim of global optimality or PPO improvement.
acceptance.failure: Reject state-routing claim if learnedconstant control matches/wins. Do not rebrand a winning secondary as preregistered primary success.

execution.precision: CUDAFP32 model/optimizer,TF32disabled,FP64maskedmetrics, compiled batchedmanualgradients with CUDAgraphs1/8/16 and fullstate capture verification.
execution.pruning: Suffixonly selectedstate_moe_js relativeMSE min_delta.001,16384barwarmup,8192half-life,median3,patience3; rawfailures distinguished from intentionalexit75. No unpruned continuation of pruned streams.
